description: This file configures and manages the Axios HTTP client for API interactions in the React project. It includes functions for URL normalization, token management, API endpoint resolution, and request/response interceptors for handling authentication tokens and retries.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a URL or string to prevent double-slash issues.

methods.name: ensureApiSuffix
methods.description: Ensures the base URL ends with '/api' or '/api/v1' to match backend endpoint structure.

methods.name: isKaviaPreviewHost
methods.description: Checks whether the current environment is within the Kavia preview environment based on hostname.

methods.name: getKaviaPreviewPublicOrigin
methods.description: Returns the public origin URL in the Kavia preview environment.

methods.name: looksLikeKaviaProxyUrl
methods.description: Determines if a URL appears to be a Kavia proxy URL.

methods.name: normalizeEnvBaseUrl
methods.description: Normalizes environment variable URL values for API base URLs, handling relative paths and common misconfigurations.

methods.name: resolveBaseUrl
methods.description: Resolves the API base URL based on environment variables and environment context like Kavia preview.

methods.name: stripApiSuffix
methods.description: Removes '/api' or '/api/v1' suffix from a URL if present.

methods.name: formatAuthorizationHeaderValue
methods.description: Formats a raw token to include 'Bearer' prefix if not already present.

methods.name: extractTokensFromResponse
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from API response data, supporting legacy formats.
